name: Dashboard KPI Cards — 8 Operational Metrics with Trends

content.description: Replace the current 4 basic stat cards on the dashboard with 8 rich KPI cards that query live DB data. The current dashboard (src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx) shows: Active Vessels, Open Bookings, Containers in Transit, Pending Customs — all as simple counts. This feature expands to 8 KPIs organized in a 2-row grid (4 per row on desktop, 2 per row on tablet, 1 per row on mobile). Each card shows: title, current value, trend indicator (up/down arrow with % change vs previous month), and a navigable link to the relevant module page. The 4 new KPIs are: Revenue MTD, Outstanding AR, Active Processes, and Pending Approvals.

kpi_specifications.title: Active Vessels
kpi_specifications.query_logic: COUNT(*) WHERE status='active' AND deletedAt IS NULL
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare current count to count at start of previous month (use createdAt for new entries)

kpi_specifications.title: Open Bookings
kpi_specifications.query_logic: COUNT(*) WHERE status NOT IN ('cancelled','completed') AND deletedAt IS NULL
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare to same count 30 days ago

kpi_specifications.title: Containers in Transit
kpi_specifications.query_logic: COUNT(*) WHERE currentStatus='in_transit' AND deletedAt IS NULL
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare to same count 30 days ago
kpi_specifications.status: existing — keep but add trend + link to tracking page

kpi_specifications.title: Pending Customs
kpi_specifications.query_logic: COUNT(*) WHERE status NOT IN ('cleared','released') AND deletedAt IS NULL
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare to same count 30 days ago

kpi_specifications.title: Revenue MTD
kpi_specifications.query_logic: SUM(totalAmount) WHERE status IN ('issued','dispatched','paid') AND issuedAt >= first day of current month AND deletedAt IS NULL. Amounts stored as integers (cents) — divide by 100 for display.
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare to SUM(totalAmount) for same date range in previous month

kpi_specifications.title: Outstanding AR
kpi_specifications.query_logic: SUM(totalOutstanding) WHERE accountStatus='active' AND deletedAt IS NULL. Integer (cents) — divide by 100.
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare to SUM(totalOutstanding) from 30 days ago snapshot. Since no historical snapshot exists, compare to SUM(totalOverdue) change direction — if overdue is increasing, trend is negative.

kpi_specifications.title: Active Processes
kpi_specifications.query_logic: COUNT(*) WHERE status IN ('pending','in_progress','waiting_approval') AND deletedAt IS NULL
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare to count of processes started this month vs last month (createdAt filter)

kpi_specifications.title: Pending Approvals
kpi_specifications.query_logic: COUNT(*) WHERE decision IS NULL AND deletedAt IS NULL
kpi_specifications.trend_logic: Compare to count of pending approvals 7 days ago — shorter window because approvals are time-sensitive

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows 8 KPI cards in a 2-row grid: 4 cards per row on lg+ screens, 2 per row on sm-md, 1 per row on mobile
All 8 KPIs display live data from DB — no hardcoded values
Each card shows a trend indicator: green up-arrow with +X% for positive trends, red down-arrow with -X% for negative trends, gray dash for no change
Revenue MTD and Outstanding AR display formatted currency values (e.g., '$125.4K' for amounts over 1000, full amount for smaller values) with the tenant's default currency from tenants.settings
Each KPI card is wrapped in a Link that navigates to the relevant module page
Trend calculation compares current period to previous period (month-over-month for counts, MTD comparison for revenue)
All queries include tenantId filter and deletedAt IS NULL (soft delete awareness)
All 8 queries run in parallel using Promise.all — page load time should not increase proportionally
The StatsCard component is enhanced to accept optional 'trend' prop: { value: number, direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral' }
Loading state shows 8 skeleton cards using the existing loading.tsx pattern (Suspense boundary)
Dark mode support: all card backgrounds, text colors, and borders use CSS variables or dark: prefixes
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
edge_cases: No data in a table (e.g., zero invoices) — card shows '0' with no trend indicator
Previous month has zero values — trend shows 'New' badge instead of infinity%
Financial amounts overflow display — use compact notation: $1.2M, $456K, etc.
Tenant has no currency configured in settings — default to 'USD'
peProcessInstances or peApprovals tables are empty (no processes ever run) — show '0' with 'No data yet' subtitle
Database query timeout on one KPI — other 7 should still render; failed KPI shows '--' with error tooltip
Very large counts (>999,999) — use compact number format: '1.2M', '456K'
error_handling: Individual query failure: catch per-query, show '--' for that KPI, log error server-side, do not crash entire dashboard
Full DB connection failure: show all 8 cards with '--' and a banner 'Unable to load dashboard data'
Auth failure (no session): redirect to /login (existing behavior, preserve it)
Permission check: dashboard is accessible to all authenticated users — no specific permission needed
security_considerations: All queries MUST include eq(table.tenantId, tid) — multi-tenant isolation is mandatory
Financial data (revenue, AR) must not leak between tenants under any circumstance
No raw SQL — all queries via Drizzle ORM parameterized queries
Dashboard is read-only — no mutations, no CSRF needed
content.implementation_notes: Modify the existing Server Component at src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx. Keep it as a Server Component — all 8 queries run server-side. Use Promise.allSettled (not Promise.all) so individual query failures don't crash the page. Enhance the existing StatsCard component to accept an optional trend prop. Import the 4 new icons from lucide-react: DollarSign, CreditCard, Workflow (or Activity), ClipboardCheck. For currency formatting, read the tenant's default currency from the session or tenants.settings. Financial amounts are stored as integers (cents) in firmFreightInvoices.totalAmount and arccCustomerAccounts.totalOutstanding — divide by 100 for display. Use Intl.NumberFormat for currency and compact number formatting. The grid changes from lg:grid-cols-4 (single row) to two rows: keep grid-cols-4 but now with 8 cards it naturally wraps to 2 rows. Add the navigable Link wrapper around each StatsCard.

trend_calculation_approach.method: For each KPI, run TWO queries: current value and previous-period value. Previous period = same metric calculated for the prior month (or prior 30-day window for point-in-time counts). Trend % = ((current - previous) / previous) * 100, rounded to 1 decimal. If previous = 0 and current > 0, show 'New' instead of Infinity%.
trend_calculation_approach.optimization: Bundle current + previous queries into the same Promise.allSettled call — total of 16 queries, all in parallel. Each query is simple COUNT or SUM with WHERE clause — should be fast with existing indexes.

testing_requirements: Verify all 8 KPI cards render with correct titles and icons
Verify trend indicators show correct direction (up/down/neutral)
Verify currency formatting for Revenue MTD and Outstanding AR
Verify compact number formatting for large values (K, M notation)
Verify individual query failure doesn't crash other cards (Promise.allSettled resilience)
Verify responsive grid: 4 cols on lg, 2 on sm, 1 on xs
Verify tenant isolation — each query includes tenantId filter
Verify Link navigation on each card works correctly
